full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the rule in short are that the present opposite party nos. 1 and 2 as plaintiff filed the suit for cancellation of deed no. 4493 dated 24.11.2013 before the Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Khulna and the case is that the suit property was acquired by the Government and the same was allotted to the defendant no.1 vide registered lease deed no. 1438 of 97 dated 23.06.1997 and subsequently mutated in their name vide Misc Case no. 285/2002-3 and accordingly recorded in the SA Khatian No. 21 /3. The defendant no. 1 constructed a 2 storied dwelling house thereon and thereafter appointed her husband as attorney of the suit property through registered power of attorney deed no. 5257 dated 17.12.2012 and the attorney started joint business i.e. medicine supply business with plaintiff' and in that business caused a loss of an amount of Tk. 1 Crore which was borne by the plaintiff and there was a condition of sharing loss and profit in the agreement. As per condition the plaintiff gave Tk. 68 lac as Baina to the defendant and executed a registered Bainama being no. 1159 dated 20.04.2014 and transferred 50% of the suit property to the plaintiff and the plaintiff has been owning and possessing the same on payment of rent to the government regularly. Subsequently the defendant no. 1 transferred the suit property elsewhere vide deed in question on 21.04.2014 but the possession over the suit property is still remaining with the plaintiff wherein he has been maintaining medicine show room and doing rent a car business and he entered into possession of the suit property on 25.08.2014 vide an agreement of partnership business with the plaintiff' but he was not impleaded a party in the suit though he was a necessary party for proper adjudication of the case and for that he made an application before the court below under order 1 rule 10 for addition of party as defendant but that application was rejected on 09.09.2014 by the learned Joint District Judge, 1st court, Khulna vide order dated 01.09.2014 and being aggrieved by the same the petitioner moved before this Division.
